recommendation: B engineering first, A certificate interface and independent verifier. No automatic promotion of estimates.

alternatives.A: Validated outer enclosures over full domain, feasible upper witnesses and interval prior integration
alternatives.B: Adaptive engineering, estimates and diagnostics only where error unbounded; certified trivial bounds kept separately

fixed_models.background: BAO denominator rd_free; CMB rstar standard

domain_and_priors.unit_cube: Exact affine map of original prior coordinates. pi_i(xi) dxi = du; no fitted boxes.
domain_and_priors.integration_partition: Disjoint interiors, boundaries counted once or zero prior measure, exact rational cell mass

fixed_shared_model.nuisance_measure: same kappa d_eta on R^63, relative only
fixed_shared_model.scenario_family: Entire frozen list from adopted contract;600 candidate labels are not yet600 qualified joint matrices

target.g: inf over the entire D_i of q
target.geometry: Common affine support, X in support with rank63, R_s X=0 and R_s C_s R_s^T=I

bound_profile.output: CellBounds valid for every point, plus dependencies

certify_witness.output: finite upper on actual q or UncertifiedEstimate

compare_models.output: existing statistic and pairwise evidence intervals

minimum_assembly.prune: Only certified cell lower>=current certified upper, with retained coverage/prune ledger
minimum_assembly.dual_lower: max(0, interval_lower(2 v^T (y-mu(B))-v^T C v)); exact X^T v=0 required

error_propagation.covariance_distinction: stipulated covariance, numerical representation error and physical inadequacy are separate
error_propagation.inverse_bound: On fixed support: ||Cinv-Chatinv|| <= e_C/[lambda*(lambda-e_C)] with verified lambda>e_C
error_propagation.engine_error: Uniform on each entire cell and required fields; resolution agreement is diagnostic only
error_propagation.beta_fixed: ALPHA_FINE_CODATA_2018*sqrt(e) in runtime with representation certificate
error_propagation.physical_approximation: Declared CAMB/RECFAST target separate from numerical solution error and physical sampling adequacy

evidence.I: integral_Di exp(-q/2)*pi_i dxi = integral_unit_cube exp(-q(T_i(u))/2) du
evidence.common_factor_cancellation: Only same C,X,support,units,nuisance measure and parameter-independent factor per scenario
evidence.logJ_certificate: Requires interval log(A_s) plus log(I_i); omit log(kappa) as explicit common unknown. Ratios may cancel A_s symbolically.
evidence.unknown_cell: [0,w_k] contribution, NOT likelihood zero; preserve failure flag
evidence.zero_lower_bound: insufficient_lower_bound, extended interval; not measured log zero
evidence.report: five relative logJ and ten pairwise ratios per scenario; ranges over scenarios not posterior intervals

statistic_lowers.Q1: max(0,L1-U3) only if H1 subset H3 qualified

decision_integration.tail_consumer: Existing qualified upper-tail contract, including df0 and complete scenario list; no new tail algorithm here
decision_integration.FWER: min(1,5*max_s p_upper_s), subject to existing V2 completeness
decision_integration.probabilistic_error_budget: No positive failure probability proposed; any future one allocated inside unchanged alpha
decision_integration.weak_certificate: L=0 may imply valid loose p=1, not missing calibration if all other hypotheses are qualified
decision_integration.incomplete_scenario: No automatic complete non-rejection from placeholder p=1 or partial list

runtime.target_runtime_source: background_metadata admitted snapshot, not new availability test
required: bounded output and actual memory enforcement
runtime.uncertain_unit: Recover identity/receipt; never automatic rerun or rename
